facts.fact: ARN-TIC, by Despacho 15/CA/ARN/2026, extended to 31 December 2026 the provisional General Authorisation held by Starlink Guiné-Bissau SARL for satellite internet services, to ensure continuity during the transition to the definitive General Authorisation regime.
ARN-TIC granted Starlink a provisional licence in December 2024, per Connecting Africa.
ARN-TIC gave Starlink final approval to operate in April 2025, per Connecting Africa.

Starlink launched in Guinea-Bissau (article dated 2025-06-19; no launch day given); consumers buy kits and service directly from Starlink's website, standard kit XOF228,000, plans from XOF18,000 a month for 250GB residential.

slug: 2025-04-10 ARN-TIC grants Starlink Guinea-Bissau provisional authorization

facts.fact: ARN-TIC granted Starlink Guiné-Bissau a provisional General Authorisation on 10 April 2025 to offer internet access over satellite in the national market.
ARN states Starlink itself is the only entity licensed to operate the Starlink service in Guinea-Bissau and requests must be made directly to it.

ARN states that unauthorised entities are illegally selling internet over the Starlink network, that using such services violates the law, and that it will intensify enforcement, including possible confiscation of illegal equipment and sanctions.

slug: 2025-08-29 Fibre-optic deployment - Guinea-Bissau wants to learn from Chad

facts.fact: Guinea-Bissau approved the commercial launch of Starlink in April 2025, per Agence Ecofin.
MyBroadband's table of Starlink status in African countries lists Guinea-Bissau as 'Available' as of 17 July 2026 (article date used, no launch date given).
TechnoMag lists Guinea-Bissau among the countries where Starlink is 'Active Now' as of mid-2026 (article date used, no launch date given).
Digital Watch Observatory says Starlink received regulatory approval in Guinea-Bissau in 2025.

note: Meeting on a new title Starlink must obtain; no licence or sale stated.

facts.fact: TeleGeography lists Starlink as live in Guinea-Bissau since June 2025.
MyBroadband says Starlink's availability map showed Guinea-Bissau as Available on 29 September 2025.
